import { getAccessToken } from "/src/api/authSession.js";
import { PrepCenterApiError } from "/src/features/teacher-prep-center/api/prepCenterApi.ts";
export const DECK_API_BASE = "/api/teacher-v3/artifacts/decks";
function authHeader() {
  const token = getAccessToken();
  return token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {};
}
async function deckRequest(deckId, path, init) {
  let res;
  try {
    res = await fetch(`${DECK_API_BASE}/${encodeURIComponent(deckId)}${path}`, {
      ...init,
      headers: {
        Accept: "application/json",
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        ...authHeader(),
        ...init.headers || {}
      }
    });
  } catch (e) {
    throw new PrepCenterApiError({ kind: "network", status: null, code: null, detail: e?.message });
  }
  const body = await res.json().catch(() => null);
  if (!res.ok || !body || typeof body.code === "number" && body.code !== 0) {
    const status = res.status;
    let kind = "error";
    if (status === 401) kind = "unauthenticated";
    else if (status === 403) kind = "forbidden";
    else if (status === 409) kind = "conflict";
    else if (status === 404) kind = "not_found";
    else if (status === 429) kind = "rate_limited";
    throw new PrepCenterApiError({
      kind,
      status,
      code: typeof body?.code === "number" ? body.code : null,
      detail: body?.message || body?.detail || `deck api error: ${status}`,
      requestId: body?.request_id ?? null
    });
  }
  return body.data ?? body;
}
export async function fetchDeckAssetUrl(deckId, assetId, signal) {
  return deckRequest(
    deckId,
    `/assets/${encodeURIComponent(assetId)}/url`,
    { method: "GET", signal }
  );
}
export function newIdempotencyKey() {
  return crypto?.randomUUID?.() ?? `pc-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
}
export function createDeckPatch(deckId, payload, signal) {
  return deckRequest(deckId, "/patches", {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify({
      idempotency_key: newIdempotencyKey(),
      source: "human",
      ...payload
    }),
    signal
  });
}
export function applyDeckPatch(deckId, patchId, expectedRevision, signal) {
  return deckRequest(deckId, `/patches/${encodeURIComponent(patchId)}/apply`, {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify({ expected_revision: expectedRevision }),
    signal
  });
}
export function regenDeckPage(deckId, payload, signal) {
  return deckRequest(deckId, "/regen", {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    signal
  });
}
export function ensureDeckFigures(deckId, payload, signal) {
  return deckRequest(deckId, "/figures", {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    signal
  });
}
export function enrichDeck(deckId, expectedRevision, signal) {
  return deckRequest(deckId, "/enrich", {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify({ expected_revision: expectedRevision }),
    signal
  });
}
export function addDeckPage(deckId, payload, signal) {
  return deckRequest(deckId, "/pages", {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    signal
  });
}
export function getDeckQa(deckId, signal) {
  return deckRequest(deckId, "/qa", { method: "GET", signal });
}
